QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_20

question.text: The maximum single-investee concentration limit for a Category III AIF is:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI restricts a Category III AIF's exposure to a single investee company to 10% of AUM or investable funds, whether directly or through units of other AIFs. The Trap: Option B is too strict. Option C is the Category I/II limit (25%). Option D would defeat diversification entirely. Note: The 10% cap applies to Category III AIFs per the prudential norms in the AIF Regulations chapter of the workbook.
